Name: Joshaphat the Mithnite
Summary: Mighty man of David, called the Mithnite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:43: Mighty man of David, called the Mithnite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joshaphat in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
